result.title: Certifying Retraining Regret through Residual Structure
result.comment: 46 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/Peida-Lee/certifying-retraining-regret
result.summary: We certify a fixed ridge predictor's regret against full-feature retraining over every continuous completion of an interval-valued table. Our main theorem gives verifiable original-row residual conditions for a uniform error bound independent of nuisance-feature scale and rank, with an asymptotically sharp leading constant and quantitative leakage stability. Full-rank constructions separate certification dimension from feature dimension, including examples requiring directions beyond the candidate. Observed-row anchors make the conditions computable, while exact row geometry and global search return valid upper bounds and feasible original-table witnesses. A finite-scale contraction and common-domain moment fallback implement the structural result. Four real-world tasks retain all model features and certify twenty rank-three instances to width $10^{-5}$. Their primary median widths improve over centered moments. Joint residual refinement additionally certifies all twenty new response-independent masks to the same precision within 76.21 seconds. For a concrete fixed-point predictor contract, pure energy certifies thirteen of fifteen stopping decisions in ten seconds, versus five for moments. Refinement certifies all fifteen within 91.68 seconds at the same objective threshold.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究区间值表格所有连续补全下，固定 ridge 预测器相对全特征重训练的 regret 认证：给出基于原始行残差的可验证一致误差界、可计算的原始表见证，并在真实任务与定点预测器契约上测试认证宽度与停止决策。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉或多模态推理无直接联系，但其「用残差/能量条件给出可计算上界与见证来认证固定点停止决策」的思路，可能为 latent 推理中的 STOP 决策验证与证据充分性判断提供启发性工具，可供核查迁移空间。
